meta.description: CV and resume for Daniel Peters, Interaction Designer & Product Designer.

header.name: Daniel Peters
header.role: Interaction Designer | M.Sc. User Experience Design
header.summary: Strategic Interaction Designer specializing in simplifying high-complexity systems. I break down dense enterprise workflows into lean, intuitive experiences that bridge the gap between business requirements and technical feasibility. Passionate about user trust, AI/ML UX research, and building the open web.
header.coreRoles: Interaction Design · Product Strategy · AI/ML UX Research

experience.title: Interaction Designer (Management Consultant)
experience.summary: Designed and shipped complex, data-heavy internal products for global automotive clients within a multi-disciplinary team of Engineers, PMs, and Researchers.
bullets: Systemic Complexity: Transformed fragmented compliance and diagnostic data into intuitive user journeys for 200+ expert users, ensuring high data security and trust.
Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborated daily with Engineering and Product Management to align technical feasibility with user delight, doubling sprint velocity through high-precision UI specs.
User-Evidence Based Iteration: Led iterative design cycles based on qualitative research and usability testing, reducing critical UX friction points by 80% prior to MVP launch.
Scalable Design Systems: Evolved and maintained modular design libraries to ensure UI consistency across complex enterprise architectures.

experience.title: Product Designer (Freelance)
bullets: End-to-End Execution: Partnered with tech founders to launch 10+ digital products from concept to execution, focusing on lean UX and rapid market validation.
Technical Craft: Built responsive, high-fidelity prototypes and web experiences with a deep understanding of browser-based implementation (HTML/CSS/Webflow).

experience.title: UX Design & Research Intern
bullets: User Research: Conducted guerrilla testing and in-depth interviews to translate patient needs into intuitive health-tracking features.
Iterative Craft: Synthesized user support data into refined UI mockups, improving accessibility and user trust within a high-privacy health environment.
